title: SAP accounting document: the link from billing to accounting, in ECC (BKPF/BSEG) and S/4HANA (BKPF/ACDOCA)
status_note: A small module that shows the variant mechanism; the finance module itself (G/L accounts, open items, cost objects) is a next step, see docs/SAP.md. Nothing here is checked against an SAP system by this project.

variants.ecc: SAP ERP 6.0 (ECC): the accounting document is BKPF (header) and BSEG (lines). Not verified per enhancement package.
variants.s4hana: SAP S/4HANA: the universal journal ACDOCA holds the line items; BKPF remains the header. Whether BSEG is read as a table or a compatibility view depends on release and is not asserted here.

tables.name: BKPF
tables.note: BELNR is unique only within company code and fiscal year: all three are needed, with MANDT.

tables.name: BSEG
tables.note: Amounts are unsigned; SHKZG says debit or credit.

tables.name: ACDOCA
tables.key_note: The client column of ACDOCA is RCLNT, not MANDT, and the ledger RLDNR is part of the key: one posting has a line per ledger.
tables.note: Amounts are signed. Filter on one ledger (RLDNR) before summing, or each posting counts once per ledger.

relationships.condition: Set once the billing document has been posted to accounting; empty before that.

traps.title: One line per ledger in ACDOCA
traps.text: ACDOCA carries the ledger in its key; a company with a leading and a parallel ledger has each posting twice. Pick a ledger before summing.

traps.title: The client column is not always called MANDT
traps.text: ACDOCA names its client column RCLNT and its company code RBUKRS. The pack maps them to MANDT and BUKRS of BKPF explicitly.
